title: Slogans, Indian Flag-Tearing: Khalistani Protesters Target Rahul Gandhi's Convoy During US Visit

ai.summary: Pro-Khalistan demonstrators reportedly tried to block Rahul Gandhi's convoy during his US visit, raising slogans in support of Khalistan and allegedly tearing the Indian national flag.
